# Cncf Fugue Reviewer

Review Fugue using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. Fugue empowers cloud engineering and security teams to move faster with confidence in their cloud security. Use Fugue to secure the entire development lifecycle—from infrastructure as code through CI/CD and runtime—using a unified policy engine powered by the Open Policy Agent (OPA), the open source standard for policy as code.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
